quotes.text: The law of the Braided River: return half of what you receive.
So the larger portion goes home — the planter must never be poorer for trusting me.

Give first.

note: Terse aphoristic myth-lines; full sends, returns past half.

if they return about half, I end up better off than by keeping everything
